tiers.name: Synchronous Socket `await writer.drain()` Inside Engine Output Loop (Head-of-Line Batch Stall)
tiers.note: A single slow client with a full TCP send buffer stalls the shared asyncio output loop, dragging P99 TPOT for all 230 healthy users to 195ms!

tiers.name: Unbounded Per-Request `asyncio.Queue()` Decoupling (Gateway RAM Explosion + Long KV Hold)
tiers.note: Decouples engine loop from slow sockets, but buffering thousands of JSON SSE chunks + logprobs per stalled client blows past 32GB container RAM -> OOMKilled!

tiers.name: Bounded Per-Request Queue + Engine Decode Pause on Full Queue (Pins GPU KV Cache)
tiers.note: Caps gateway RAM at 1.8 GB, but pausing generation for a slow reader pins its 4GB GPU KV Cache in HBM for 160s, starving new requests!

tiers.name: In-Place Token-Coalescing Bounded Ring Buffer (`max_chunks=64`) + Slow-Reader Write Timeout Abort
tiers.note: Coalesces pending tokens into a single string chunk when socket lags (10x fewer syscalls) and aborts dead/stalled readers after 15s -> 18.5ms P99 TPOT & 1.1GB RAM!
